# `db/queries/preview-instances.ts`

Module for querying tasks that have an active or historical preview status. Provides typed access to preview instance data, ordered by most recently started.

---

- [Functions](#functions)
  - [`getPreviewInstances`](#getpreviewinstances)

  - [`PreviewInstanceRow`](#previewinstancerow)

## Functions

### `getPreviewInstances`

Returns all tasks with a non-null `previewStatus`, ordered by `previewStartedAt` descending (most recent first).

**Signature**

```ts
import { getPreviewInstances } from 'db/queries/preview-instances';

getPreviewInstances(): Promise<PreviewInstanceRow[]>
```

**Parameters**

None.

**Returns**

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `Promise<PreviewInstanceRow[]>` | Resolves to an array of preview instance rows. Returns an empty array if no tasks have a `previewStatus` set. |

**Example**

```ts
import { getPreviewInstances } from 'db/queries/preview-instances';

const instances = await getPreviewInstances();

for (const instance of instances) {
  console.log(`${instance.title} — port ${instance.previewPort} — status ${instance.previewStatus}`);
}
```

## Types & Interfaces

### `PreviewInstanceRow`

Represents a single row returned by [`getPreviewInstances`](#getpreviewinstances). Each row corresponds to a task that has a non-null `previewStatus`.

```ts
interface PreviewInstanceRow {
  taskId: string;
  title: string;
  repoFullName: string | null;
  previewPort: number | null;
  previewStatus: string;
  previewStartedAt: Date | null;
}
```

**Members**

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `taskId` | `string` | Unique identifier of the task. |
| `title` | `string` | Human-readable title of the task. |
| `repoFullName` | `string \| null` | Full repository name (e.g. `"owner/repo"`), or `null` if not associated with a repository. |
| `previewPort` | `number \| null` | Port number on which the preview is served, or `null` if no port has been assigned. |
| `previewStatus` | `string` | Current status of the preview (e.g. `"running"`, `"stopped"`). Always non-null. |
| `previewStartedAt` | `Date \| null` | Timestamp when the preview was started, or `null` if it has not been started. |
